input.title: [Allegion Declares Quarterly Dividend]
input.body:
Allegion Declares Quarterly Dividend

DUBLIN--(BUSINESS WIRE)--
[Allegion plc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.allegion.com%2F&esheet=52996063&newsitemid=20221201005927&lan=en-US&anchor=Allegion+plc&index=1&md5=121be690e7bcf69fd970c329302211e0) (NYSE: ALLE), a leading global security products and solutions provider, today announced that its board of directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.41 per ordinary share of the company.

The dividend is payable on Dec. 30, 2022, to shareholders of record on Dec. 16, 2022.

**About Allegion**

Allegion (NYSE: ALLE) is a global pioneer in seamless access, with leading brands like CISA®, Interflex®, LCN®, Schlage®, SimonsVoss® and Von Duprin®. Focusing on security around the door and adjacent areas, Allegion secures people and assets with a range of solutions for homes, businesses, schools and institutions. Allegion had $2.9 billion in revenue in 2021, and its security products are sold around the world.

For more, visit [www.allegion.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.allegion.com&esheet=52996063&newsitemid=20221201005927&lan=en-US&anchor=www.allegion.com&index=2&md5=8005c9a3773c197a167af658d35c1486).
